notes: Dashboard cards fill their row: lists, chat and checks take the room they are given.
Server settings, redesigned: a rail of groups, a search across all of them, presets, and edits that wait until you press Save.
The titlebar says what the world is doing from every page, copies the join address, and keeps every notice behind a bell.
Press ? for the keyboard sheet, Ctrl+B for the sidebar as a rail; the palette remembers what you ran and finds every setting.
Doctor findings can wait a week and copy as text; a backup can carry a note; the console pins lines and filters by player.
The MOTD previews its colours, presets fill the quick properties, the mod list orders and copies, and the World appearance follows the world's own daylight.
Fenrir Connect copies the world's address, sends a test notification, opens the screenshots folder and shows an install's progress in the taskbar.
No build or version numbers anywhere you read; the support bundle still carries them.
